description: This file defines a GUI widget for analyzing and plotting network data, including functions for plotting, data management, and user interaction, specifically for a tool called 'beerocks_analyzer'. It includes class definitions, plotting setup, and data handling methods.

classes.name: FixedOrderFormatter
classes.description: Custom scalar formatter for fixed order of magnitude display on axes.

classes.name: UpdateSig
classes.description: QObject subclass with a Signal for inter-thread communication.

classes.name: BeeRocksAnalyzerWidget
classes.description: Main QWidget class for network data analysis and plotting, handling data parsing, plot updates, and user interaction.

methods.name: makeBarCollection
methods.description: Creates a matplotlib PatchCollection for bar chart visualization.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the analyzer widget, setting up GUI components and data structures.

methods.name: closeEvent
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the widget is closed.

methods.name: getCommandLineArgs
methods.description: Parses command line arguments to configure the widget.

methods.name: printUsage
methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the tool.

methods.name: printLabels
methods.description: Logs all attribute labels ending with '_v'.

methods.name: printVals
methods.description: Logs all attribute values ending with '_v' or '_t'.

methods.name: readSampleAndUpdateGraphs
methods.description: Reads a data line, updates internal data, and triggers plot updates based on timing.

methods.name: readSample
methods.description: Parses a data line, updates internal data structures for network map and stats.

methods.name: getAttrVal
methods.description: Retrieves attribute value and timestamp by name.

methods.name: getValByName
methods.description: Returns attribute value array by name.

methods.name: getTimeByName
methods.description: Returns attribute timestamp array by name.

methods.name: getTimeDiffSec
methods.description: Calculates seconds difference from a start time.

methods.name: addAttr
methods.description: Adds a new attribute value and timestamp, possibly creating new plot lines.

methods.name: defineLineColor
methods.description: Assigns a color index to an entity (AP or station).

methods.name: addRemoveNewFigSubplots
methods.description: Manages addition or removal of plot lines and labels in figures.

methods.name: updatePlotData
methods.description: Updates plot lines with latest data, adjusts axes, and redraws figures.

methods.name: getMinMax
methods.description: Calculates min and max of a data vector.

methods.name: deleteOldSamples
methods.description: Removes data points outside the current time window.

methods.name: setYticks
methods.description: Sets y-axis tick formatter based on data range.

methods.name: getLineColor
methods.description: Retrieves color for an entity based on its assigned index.

methods.name: addPlots
methods.description: Creates and adds plot figures and axes based on configuration.
